events.title: First time game launching in Polish fix + some changes
events.summary: Upon the first launch, the game is intended to be in English. Unfortunately, it was starting up in Polish, which posed a significant issue for anyone unfamiliar with the language. I have fixed this and, while I was at it, made a few minor adjustments. Everything should now work without any problems.CHANGELOG:1. events.title: New demo is here!
events.summary: After nearly a month of work, the new demo is ready. It features Polish language support, an improved city, customer preferences, and a new tutorial system. Unfortunately, due to issues with the plugin handling advanced dialogue, I had to cut those features. It’s not a major loss, though, as there were only a few of them. Have fun!

events.title: New demo is coming!
events.summary: The new demo is on the way. It will be based on the new, updated version of the template (2.0x instead of 1.9x). New features: Polish language, Polish currency and some changes like customer preferences. Can't wait to upload it! Lighting and post processing is turned off in the editor.

events.title: Game braking bug in DEMO
events.summary: Save system is broken... Hello! Unfortunately, one of the updates broke the save system in the demo version. I sincerely apologize for this and want to let you know that I'm working on a solution. I've identified several potential causes and will be investigating them one by one. Fixing this bug is my top priority right now. Again, I apologize.

events.title: Demo update
events.summary: I've fixed some serious bugs like no cashier spawning and added graphics options. It's still in beta but I'm learning how to improve it.
